description: The pie chart presents the distribution of data across task categories for the referenced paper, showing 6 slices in total. The slices are labeled with percentages and are color-coded to match a legend titled “Categories” that also lists counts: chat is shown in light pink/red at about 41.2% (546,526), math in blue at about 21.9% (290,496), tooluse in light green at about 11.6% (154,358), multi turn chat in light orange/peach at about 9.3% (123,615), code in light lavender/purple at about 9.0% (119,563), and instruction follow in light pink/magenta at about 6.9% (91,460). Percentage labels appear outside the slices next to their category names, no slices are exploded or otherwise emphasized, and the segments appear arranged roughly from largest to smaller portions around the circle.
